traits.leaf_arrangement.note: APweb, Geraniales page (read 2026-10-16): leaves spiral in Geraniaceae and Bersameae, opposite in Vivianieae.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Geraniales page (read 2026-10-16): leaves spiral; opposite only in Vivianieae and on upper stems of some Geranieae.

traits.division_pattern.note: APweb, Geraniales page (read 2026-10-16): blades palmate, pinnate or simple. Palmate lobing weighted 'usually' because Geranium (307 spp) and most Pelargonium are palmately lobed; Erodium pinnate.

traits.life_span.note: APweb, Geraniales page (read 2026-10-16): mostly herbs; Francoaceae trees to perennial herbs; annuals in Vivianieae and some Geranieae.

traits.corolla_shape.note: APweb, Geraniales page (read 2026-10-16): five free petals, mostly regular; inferred as spreading (open saucer).

traits.hypanthium.note: APweb, Geraniales page (read 2026-10-16): no hypanthium described; Pelargonium has a receptacular nectary tube, not a floral cup.

traits.carpels.note: APweb, Geraniales page (read 2026-10-16): carpels 2-7 in the order; (2-)5 in Geranieae.
